Asset naming: the five BRAT_ASSETS entries recorded here (main.js, manifest.json, manifest-beta.json, styles.css, versions.json) are the versioned repository files that must stay aligned and hashed. The GitHub Release itself carries the three files BRAT actually downloads (main.js, manifest.json, styles.css); manifest-beta.json and versions.json are consumed from the repository tree. This distinction was previously unstated and made the ledger look inconsistent with the published asset list.

2.0.8 carries three fixes: the settings jump (openObsidianSettings() called open() before openTabById(), and the account modal passed a LiveSync settings *group* id where Obsidian expects a tab id — the group objects carry no id at all); the colour preset (toAppearance() wrote `preset` into `colourPreset`, so any non-theme typography preset silently applied that preset's hard-coded palette and the chat surface stopped following the Obsidian theme); and the sync provisioning gate (a first activation returned an empty setup_uri while provisioning was still pending, which the plugin reported as a hard failure).

Correction to earlier notes: "the stable channel still resolves to 2.0.4" described the Obsidian community directory listing, not what an installed client can receive. Obsidian determines the latest version from `manifest.json` in the repository default branch (and consults `versions.json` for compatibility), then downloads the assets of the GitHub release whose tag matches that version; the GitHub pre-release badge does not gate client updates. The badge only affects which releases the community directory ingests, which is why its listing page showed 2.0.4 while clients could already update past it.

The Obsidian community directory has its own ingest cadence. The 2.0.9 release became non-prerelease on 2026-09-17, but the directory listing (Current version / Review scan target) still showed 2.0.4 immediately afterwards and is expected to catch up on its next scan.

2.0.12 carries the activation reroute (activation now rewrites the remote configuration profile named by activeConfigurationId together with the top-level couchDB_* keys, because LiveSync 2.x overlays the active profile over the top level and a top-level-only write was reverted by the old endpoint on a device that already had a profile), pins remoteType to CouchDB during activation so a legacy minio/p2p value cannot route the replicator to the wrong remote, and presets the official service address https://api4.sacu3.cn while migrating the historical official endpoints so a fresh install can activate after pasting a card key.

2.0.13 is reserved by the branch release/2.0.13 at cut commit 5f86f45; it is unpublished. The candidate carries no tag, releaseUrl or publishedAt on purpose: utils/verify-osyc-collaboration.mjs treats a candidate without a tag as a reserved line ahead of the stable release, so the reviewed tree may carry 2.0.13 while currentStable still names 2.0.11. Publication stays with the release-captain (featureAgentsMayPublish is false) and is the usual fast-forward of main, which makes publish-release-assets.yml create 2.0.13 as a normal release.

There is no runtime change; the five versioned assets were rebuilt and re-hashed, and tsc, svelte-check, the iOS 15 compatibility check and 136 unit-test files / 1019 tests all passed.
